# Historical Price Plateaus & Unobserved Months Audit (`docs/tables/history_plateaus_check.md`)

*Generated by [`src/evaluate/verify_history_plateaus.py`](../../src/evaluate/verify_history_plateaus.py) — do not edit by hand.*

### Key Audit Findings
1. **Zero Imputation in Raw or Processed Series:** Every single observed price (`is_observed == 1`) in `data/processed/modeling_panel_2019_2026.csv` matches an explicit `pricetype='Retail', unit='KG', priceflag='actual'` record in `data/raw/wfp_food_prices_ben.csv` (`100%` `actual` flags across all `4,162` Maize, `3,664` Tomato, and `1,603` White Yam observations).
2. **Why Dantokpa White Maize Has Multi-Month Plateaus:** In `data/raw/wfp_food_prices_ben.csv`, Dantokpa retail maize prices are recorded from standard market volume measures converted to `XOF/kg` (`priceflag='actual'`). Genuine observed constant-price runs (`>= 3` consecutive observed months) in Dantokpa for `Maize (white)` are: `192.31 XOF/kg` (4 consecutive observed months: `2020-01..2020-04`), `274.73 XOF/kg` (3 consecutive observed months: `2020-08..2020-10`), `329.67 XOF/kg` (3 consecutive observed months: `2022-04..2022-06`), `274.73 XOF/kg` (6 consecutive observed months: `2022-12..2023-05`), `275.00 XOF/kg` (3 consecutive observed months: `2023-10..2023-12`), `385.00 XOF/kg` (3 consecutive observed months: `2024-06..2024-08`), `275.00 XOF/kg` (13 consecutive observed months: `2024-10..2025-10`), `220.00 XOF/kg` (6 consecutive observed months: `2025-11..2026-04`).
3. **Unobserved Months Must Break the SVG Line (`d3.line().defined()`):** Across the `93` calendar months (`2019-01..2026-09`) in Dantokpa, **`Maize (white)` has `84/93` observed and `9` unobserved months (`2019-05, 2019-06, 2019-07, 2019-08, 2019-09, 2019-10, 2019-11, 2019-12, 2022-03`)**, **`Tomatoes` has `89/93` observed and `4` unobserved months (`2019-05, 2019-06, 2019-11, 2022-03`)**, and **`Yam (white)` has `88/93` observed and `5` unobserved months (`2019-05, 2019-06, 2019-11, 2020-08, 2022-03`)**. Previously, exporting only observed rows caused `d3.line()` to draw a straight line across the `9` unobserved months in Dantokpa (most notably bridging `2019-04` at `192.31 XOF/kg` across the `8` missing months `2019-05..2019-12` to `2020-01` at `192.31 XOF/kg`, and bridging `2022-03`). Exporting all `93` calendar months with `price: null, is_observed: false` on unobserved months and rendering with `d3.line().defined(d => d.is_observed && d.price !== null)` breaks the SVG path at every missing month.
